title: The Occlusion Effect: Why Chips Sound So Loud
caption:
Ever noticed chewing sounds LOUDER with earbuds in?
A cartoon guy pops in earbuds, bites a chip and screams. An ear diagram then names the culprit: the occlusion effect.
Earbuds seal your ear canal, so chewing sounds that normally escape bounce back and amplify by up to +20 dB.
What snack turns deafening the moment your earbuds go in?
Share this with your loudest crunching friend!
